title: Transport and observation remain subordinate to LDAP authority
rules: LDAP asks Socket Provider for reliable stream semantics and does not own L2/L3/L4 carrier choice.
XTP may provide multicast and carrier mechanics, but carrier success is not LDAP application commit.
Per-peer application ACK evidence remains explicit even when one multicast publication reaches many targets.
Retry after durable recovery targets only missing peers rather than converting multicast receipt into application acknowledgement.
Instrumentation Mesh request correlation and causation improve observability but never infer authority from time, host, topology or proximity.
An instrumentation consumer cannot promote ACTIVE/SPARE state or mutate the Identity Directory.
